notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.5.0.v [REWORK UBDATE]
notes.content: [p] [/p][h3][b]Victim Display (The City)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]"Resolves"[/p][list][*][p]A full rework of all the modifiers on "Resolves".[/p][/*][*][p]The "Resolve" frames/slots have been given a visual improvement.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update on the "Resolves" tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]"Resolves" no longer have costs.[/p][/*][*][p]A visual indicator has been added under the "resolves" for easier readability.[/p][/*][*][p]The visual of the filter has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Victim[/p][list][*][p]A new brand set of Traits/Flaws on the victims.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update on the victim's traits/Flaws.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overall[/p][list][*][p]Added a tooltip on the top Grief indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Change the "Advance" text on the hourglass to the next grief.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can offer a contract as soon as you have enough desperation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Contract[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The pentagrams have been replaced with a desperation sword to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Curse/Blessing/Miracle costs only gold now.[/p][/*][*][p]Blessing no longer provides desperation.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update on the Curse/Blessing/Miracle tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Only the valid offers will be visible during the contract stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update on the stats on the right.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Home Encanment[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The First upgrade no longer needs to be bought.[/p][/*][*][p]Enchanting a resolve no longer costs soul shards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The tutorial has been simplified.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Removed[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Sins & Virtutes & Griefs matches have been locked[/p][/*][*][p]The church has been removed for the time being.[/p][list][*][p]As well as notoriety/faith stacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Home Encanment[/p][list][*][p]The case file has been removed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Shop has been removed as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Player health has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Soul shards currency has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Favority/Removed filter is no longer.[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Gate[/p][list][*][p]Health restoration has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Erosion restoration has been removed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Contract[/p][list][*][p]Souls shards payment has been removed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.4.2.v
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3][Home Encanment][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Death point has been changed to Death Rank to avoid unnecessary confusion.

[*] Added the 2 other Fusion device parts at the shop.

[*] Soul shards cost have been removed from Death's Resolve.

[*] Death's Resolve tutorial has been oversimplified.
[/list]

[h3][Church][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added blessing Rank marker.

[*] The last blessing now is +1 Rank higher.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs & Fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed, Death's Resolve can no longer be overenchanted.

[*] Fixed, Death's Resolve will be saved upon closing the game.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.4.1.v
notes.content:
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*] New visual improvements for the main Objective (Desperation Sword).

[*] Added Battle speed option in the options.

[*] Small visual improvement when dragging resolves.

[*] Now small amounts of gold are counted as well.
[/list]


[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]

[h3][Church][/h3]

[*] Removed church max stack.

[*] Change icon notoriety to lesser confusion.

[*] Resolve now increases church Rank.

[*] Now faith stacks are gained on any contract, before it was only the soul coins.

[*] The penalty for going to church sooner has changed and got a new visual.


[h3][Shop][/h3]

[*] Shop prices have been reduced to avoid grind.

[*] Shop Items "War Declaration" now increase notoriety gains.

[/list]


[h2]Bugs & Fixes [/h2]

[list]

[*] Fixed, Casandria tip display was displaying the wrong stats.
[*] Fixed, Blessing from Rank 3 not working properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix some grammatical errors.
[*] Remove the cost of misfortune.
[*] Furnace Health cost Reduced to 1.
[*] Furance Resolve cost Rais to 2.
[*] Notority locked for the demo.
[*] Added a shelf to the contract panel.
[*] The "Deal" button at the end of the demo opens the steam page now.
[*] Remove some confusion about the "Death Preparation" requirement.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now the Resolves, Soul Coin, and Shop items can be swapped more easily.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix a bug that would make some tutorial overlap.
[*] Fix a bug that softlocks the player if it runs out of soul charges.
[/list]
